props.heading: Accessibility isn't a review step here — it's a generation default.
props.body: WCAG AA contrast compliance is baked into the palette and enforced by the pipeline before a file is rendered. A creator doesn't have to know what 4.5:1 contrast ratio means; the system will not produce a slide that fails it.

props.heading: Sequencing follows the arc — hook, predict, struggle, reveal, apply — because th
props.body: The MCP server doesn't just generate content; it generates content in the specific sequence that makes cognitive processing work.

props.heading: Facts get checked before render.
props.body: Every stated magnitude in a generated course carries a source citation — not just a claim that sounds accurate. This is infrastructure, not policy: the pipeline routes through a fact-check step before the asset is finalized.

props.heading: Quick prediction: how many design decisions does one ninety-second reel contain?
props.body: Commit to a number — the reveal puts it in the hundreds.

props.heading: Every artifact ships a decisions.json — one entry per choice.
props.body: A stakeholder can open the file, query any decision by ID, and read why that choice was made. Auditability is built in, not bolted on. The design decisions are a first-class output, not a footnote.
